visualization_settings.text:
## Borrower Health Review
Payment health & BCG · original Borrowers tab retained.

## Payment behaviour × contribution
Upper row: score ≥80 with no automatic schedule restriction. Lower row: score <80 or modified schedule. Left: contribution <1×; right: ≥1×. Unclassified remains outside the board.

**Automatic rule:** auto-charge off + interest amount OR interest-charge-date coverage <80%, with ≥7 observed days and ≥2 expected dates. Any affected active loan restricts Star/Cash Cow. Scores remain unchanged; the chart can show a high payment score for a lower category.

## Payment health · all borrowers
Includes inactive borrowers with debt. Due today is not overdue. Principal and interest must each be covered. A payment today may clear current arrears without rewriting its historical lateness. Amounts are baht; blank means unavailable.

## How the rating is calculated
Recent punctuality **45%** · older punctuality **15%** · average delay **15%** · current payment health **25%**. Missing components redistribute weight. No recent history → Unclassified. Default-altered history → Data review, no published rating. Severe arrears (>7 days) cap an otherwise available score at 60.
Contribution uses interest from the last 30 completed Bangkok days divided by the active cohort’s equal share; the high-value boundary is **1×**, independent of reliability **80**.
**Schedule rule:** categories additionally reflect modified schedules. It recalculates automatically and is not a confirmed-hardship label. No manual review or overrides.

**Freshness:** values update on report refresh; this is not a historical as-of report. Cards can query at slightly different times. Reporting context gives query time, not a guarantee of payment entry or AppSheet sync. Existing dashboard date and borrower filters do not apply to this current-portfolio review.

## Automatic schedule assessment
Current setup compared with recorded charges over 30 completed days, respecting schedule anchors. Principal is separate. Expected interest is not additional overdue debt. A lump-sum catch-up does not hide reduced charge frequency. Unsupported/short histories are labeled.
